title: What the returning sound leaves out

scenes.tts: A microphone sealed in a healthy ear canal can record sound that the cochlea made. What does that returning sound tell us about the amplifier? And what does it leave out? Kemp studied human ears. He delivered brief impulses to the closed canal. After five milliseconds, a slowly decaying component remained. In the ears with cochlear deafness that were tested, it was absent. That supports a cochlear source. It does not identify a motor.

scenes.tts: Outer hair cells shorten and lengthen with voltage. The protein prestin is the motor. Now think about speed. A tone at twenty kilohertz, near the top of the human range, completes a cycle every fifty microseconds. Prestin responds to voltage, without burning A T P each cycle. Membrane filtering and motor speed still matter. High frequency power remains debated.

scenes.tts: How do you connect that protein to an electrical response? One answer is nonlinear capacitance. In whole cell voltage clamp, a cell with prestin shows a bell shaped capacitance. It peaks at one voltage. The usual reading is that it reports voltage dependent movement of charge in the protein.

scenes.tts: A minimal model has two states. Depolarization shifts prestin toward a contracted state. Butan and colleagues fitted gerbil prestin in a cell line. Half activation was at minus one hundred twelve millivolts, with an effective charge of zero point seven. At that voltage, half the protein is contracted, and capacitance is at its peak. Fifty millivolts more positive, occupancy rises to about zero point eight. Capacitance falls to about sixty four percent of the peak.

Capacitance falls to about 64% of the peak.

scenes.tts: This is charge movement in a cell line, under stated assumptions. It does not say how much force or power a hair cell produces. The structures show purified protein under chosen anion or drug conditions. The human structures in chloride and salicylate differ by about two hundred square angstroms. That compares two structures. It is not a stroke measured in a hair cell.

scenes.tts: Each answer comes from a different preparation, and none of them is complete. The returning sound supports a cochlear source. The capacitance curve reports charge movement. The structures show purified protein under chosen conditions. Read them as complementary views, not one settled movie.
